headlines.text: On a Sunday in 2024, back when Swerve Strickland vs. Will Ospreay clashed for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 9.23 ? a stone-cold classic. In a Match of the Year contender, Strickland kicked out of the Hidden Blade twice before finally putting Ospreay away with a third House Call and Big Pressure to retain the AEW World Title.
Back on this day in 2023, Samoa Joe vs. Roderick Strong met in an Owen Hart Tournament Match, headlining the show on Collision, rated 7.32 ? a good, competitive contest.

Back on this day in 2021, MJF vs. Sammy Guevara headlined Dynamite, rated 8.21 ? one of the better matches of the year in a hard-fought men's division clash ? part of that year's Fan Appreciation Night '21.

secondaries.text: Flash back to 2024, when the AEW TNT Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Jack Perry vs. Dante Martin vs. El Phantasmo vs. Konosuke Takeshita vs. Lio Rush vs. Mark Briscoe battled it out in a Ladder match, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.68 ? a well-paced, entertaining battle ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. El Phantasmo and Lio Rush and Mark Briscoe was challenging for gold for the very first time. Perry hung back and picked his spots amid a violent ladder war filled with Takeshita brainbusters on ladders, capitalizing to win the vacant TNT Championship.

Rewind to 2024, when gold changed shoulders as the IWGP World Heavyweight Title found a new champion as Tetsuya Naito vs. Jon Moxley battled it out, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 4.23 ? ending the champion's reign at 2 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Tetsuya Naito's career. Naito hit the Destino to defeat Moxley, unifying the IWGP and AEW International Titles and becoming the sole heavyweight champion between the two promotions.

That Sunday in 2024, the AEW TBS Title was up for grabs as Mercedes Mone vs. Stephanie Vaquer went to war, appearing on Forbidden Door, rated 7.61 ? a strong outing. For Stephanie Vaquer, it marked a first real shot at championship gold.
